title: Solving Vell's backstory via the Hall of Ledgers (instead of the originally-pointed Hollowbrook Keepers' Hall) closed 'The Exile's Ledger' with the line 'its asker's wish is past meeting,' and the final status lists it under 'Failed' even though the underlying truth was found and read aloud at the throne — confusing scoring for what felt like success via an alternate route.
where: Marrowgate / The Hall of Ledgers, founding ledger

evidence.quote: Solving Vell's backstory via the Hall of Ledgers (instead of the originally-pointed Hollowbrook Keepers' Hall) closed 'The Exile's Ledger' with the line 'its asker's wish is past meeting,' and the final status lists it under 'Failed' even though the underlying truth was found and read aloud at the throne — confusing scoring for what felt like success via an alternate route.
